finding.surface: root Inspector -> responsive flex/grid item styles -> public authored page root
finding.problem: The authored root is a child of the normal-flow .content-page wrapper. The live Inspector already suppressed flex item (flexGrow, flexShrink, flexBasis, alignSelf) and grid item (gridColumn, gridRow) controls because the root has no Flex/Grid parent; however, the static per-node capability contract advertised these six fields for root types.
finding.effect: The static capability contract overstated root editability even though the visible Inspector behavior was already context-filtered. Child nodes remain eligible because their parent can be switched to Flex or Grid.

change.behavior: Exclude only ROOT from flex.grow, flex.shrink, flex.basis, flex.alignSelf, grid.column, and grid.row in the static capability contract. Add declarative layoutContext metadata for Flex/Grid container and item fields; the live Inspector derives breakpoint-specific visibility from that metadata.
change.root_filter_helper: nonRootNodeTypes is shared by the existing root overflow restriction and these item-only properties.
change.ui_behavior_before_fix: Already context-filtered; no visible Inspector control needed to be removed.
